Saturday Summary: Cosmic Crusader bookends season

Exciting juvenile filly Scintillation will head to the G3 Quezette Stakes after a strong win at Randwick. In Melbourne, debutant Doubt Time had everyone talking with a thrilling display, while nicely bred fillies Misato and Somerford look to be on the improve.

It's the last Saturday metropolitan meeting of the season, and Eviction Notice, Milson's Point, and Ghana's Akan are amongst the 2-year-olds looking to tick off another win before they turn three. Grahame Begg has two mares vying with Winnasedge for the G3 Bletchingly Stakes, and Ciaron Maher has a regal mare stepping up at Caulfield.

G2 Caulfield Sprint winner Graff will join the Eureka Stud roster in 2026 to take advantage of the state where his best son, Grafterburners, is trained. The stakes-producing son of Star Witness will stand his sixth season for a fee of $9900 inc GST.

A third set of metropolitan trials at Rosehill Gardens dominated Friday morning, with Apocalyptic and Savvy Hallie preparing to reload for bigger, better spring campaigns. A bevy of eyecatching juveniles stepped out, including the return of I'm Ya Huckleberry and red hot Mille Feuille.

Cosmic Crusader returns in Saturday’s Bletchingly Stakes with the chance to cap another remarkable season for Peters Investments. Behind the results is a tightly run family operation, decades of patience and a breeding philosophy that has barely changed while the industry around it has.

Successful breeder and racehorse owner Dr Gene Tsoi is holding a dispersal sale this week. After 30 years in the industry, Tsoi is retiring but he’ll take his memories with him. TTR spoke to Marcus Corban about the sale and his long list of successes.

For more than three decades, Andrew "Butch" Castles has been one of New Zealand racing's most respected racing administrators. On Friday, the industry he has given so much to will come together in Hamilton to celebrate friendship, support his family into the future and honour an enduring legacy.

From the glitz of the Gold Coast to the provinces, Magic Millions have opened entries for the 2027 yearling sales series. Their showcase sale at the Gold Coast will take place in January, while entries are also open for Tasmania, Perth, Adelaide, and the Gold Coast March sale. Entries close on August 14, 2026.
